chars.UNCLE: UNCLE: a middle-aged man wearing a long cream-white djellaba with a pointed hood down, a small white knitted prayer cap on his head, brown prayer beads in his hand.
chars.ME: ME: a young man in his twenties wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black jogger pants.
chars.KID: KID: a teenage boy wearing a lime-green tracksuit and a black cap worn backwards.
chars.AUNT: AUNT: a woman wearing a turquoise house kaftan and a pink headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the hallway doorway of a Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas: UNCLE stands mid-sermon, wagging his index finger angrily and preaching with his mouth wide open, glaring toward the TV. Head-to-waist framing, his face clearly visible, comic exaggerated anger.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night: AUNT and ME sit relaxed on a sedari sofa watching a TV showing a music video with colourful lights, AUNT clapping along happily, ME smiling with a glass of mint tea.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: UNCLE suddenly jumps up from the sofa shouting and pointing at ME, who freezes in shock holding the TV remote, comic panic.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On a Moroccan rooftop terrace in daylight: KID sits next to UNCLE and holds a smartphone, showing him how to set up a new social media profile; UNCLE leans in, curious and delighted, eyebrows raised.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close on the two on a sofa: KID taps the phone screen with one finger and explains enthusiastically with his other hand raised like a teacher; UNCLE nods seriously, fascinated, holding his prayer beads.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: in the foreground ME sits on the sofa watching sideways with a sly knowing smirk; in the background UNCLE stares happily at his phone, typing fast with one finger.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A dim Moroccan bedroom at night lit by a small lamp: ME lies on a bed propped on one elbow, his phone lighting up his face as a notification pops up, he raises his eyebrows in surprise.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same dim bedroom at night: ME sits up on the bed and brings the glowing phone close to his face, eyes wide and suspicious, mouth open, about to open the notification.
